apple.name: PokeSniper
apple.subtitle: Scan cards. Track value.
apple.description:
PokeSniper helps Pokémon card resellers scan English singles, confirm the print, and see a Max Buy from their own rules.

Max Buy is your rule, not a market price. Spreads are estimates and show their price source and time. PokeSniper does not promise a profit.

google.title: PokeSniper
google.fullDescription:
PokeSniper helps Pokémon card resellers scan English singles, confirm the print, and see a Max Buy from their own rules.

Max Buy is your rule, not a market price. Spreads are estimates. PokeSniper does not promise a profit.

notes: Store listing must not promise grading while the feature is off. Max Buy disclaimer must match PREGRADE_COPY. Never name a model or a grading company in this file. Slab price comparisons in the app may name companies; store listing copy may not.
